CustomField.description: The datetime of the previous status update before this one. Mirrors ssot__PreviousUpdateDateTime__c on ssot__CaseUpdate__dlm. This is the key field used by the BH_TimeToFirstClose_clc formula via MIN([Case Update].[Previous Update Date]).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Timestamp of the prior status change. For Closed rows, represents the moment just before case was closed — used for time-to-close calculation.
CustomField.label: Previous Update Date
